metadata.title: Nigeria CNG and EV station research catalog
metadata.coverageStatement: The 91-record CNG portion is a complete capture of the official Pi-CNG directory on the research date. EV coverage combines a 34-record Nigeria-focused directory, direct operator/government sources, and a Google Maps sweep of major cities. It is broad discovery coverage, not a guarantee that every charger is public or operational.
importantLimitations: Live operational status, access rules, price, connector count, and opening hours must be confirmed before routing users.
Pi-CNG publishes street addresses but not survey-grade coordinates; its own map uses approximate place-name coordinates, which are preserved and labelled here.
Battery-swap sites primarily serve compatible motorcycles and are not passenger-car chargers.
Google Maps has many false-category listings in Nigeria; obvious phone shops, ordinary auto electricians, solar installers, and uncorroborated generic businesses were excluded.
Tier C records should remain hidden from production navigation until contacted or visited.

verificationTiers.A: Official government, university, or operator listing
verificationTiers.B: Nigeria-focused directory listing described as verified
verificationTiers.C: Google Maps discovery requiring direct confirmation

coordinateEnrichment.policy: One-time, single-threaded preparation at no more than one request per second

coordinateFallbacks.method: Median of existing research coordinates in the same city, otherwise the same state
coordinateFallbacks.navigationWarning: Centroid fallbacks are discovery-only and must not be used for turn-by-turn navigation
